claim: total assets at PepsiCo came to $100.0 million in fiscal Q1 2024.
summary: PepsiCo consolidated total assets are on the order of ~$100 billion ( ~$100,000 million) in recent quarters including fiscal Q1 2024. Claimed figure of $100.0 million is three orders of magnitude too low and is inconsistent with the known scale of PepsiCo's balance sheet, indicating a unit/magnitude error.

sub_claims.note: Without tools, verified via prior knowledge: PepsiCo total assets have been ~$92-101 billion in FY2022-FY2023 and Q1 2024 (approx $100,000 million). $100.0 million understates actual figure by ~1000x; no evidence supports such low figure.

sub_claims.text: The total assets figure pertains to fiscal Q1 2024 (quarter ended March 2024)
sub_claims.note: Specific period attribution cannot be verified from evidence with no tools, but PepsiCo does report a fiscal Q1 2024 (quarter ended March 23, 2024); the magnitude error makes the combined assertion false regardless of period.
